posts.text:
The US national debt is now over $40 trillion because of decades of Republican tax breaks for billionaires and corporations.

This whole time, we could’ve instead invested in universal healthcare and childcare, boosting our economy.

GOP “fiscal responsibility" is a joke.
posts.summary: Blames Republican tax cuts for national debt; advocates universal healthcare and childcare

posts.text:
Imagine waking up tomorrow and not worrying how you will pay for healthcare, childcare, college, or taking leave from your job.

posts.text:
In America, healthcare and education are unaffordable for millions of people.

There’s always more money for wars, but never enough to actually support peoples’ lives. Americans deserve a system where every person can thrive, not just barely survive.

posts.text:
In July, Moises Velasquez was kidnapped by ICE for simply having the same car as another person they were looking for. Now, ICE’s carelessness will result in lasting trauma for him and his family.

This chaos and cruelty must end. ICE needs to be dismantled.
